days.briefingText:
DAY 1 - THE SILICON FOUNDATION (Training)
Focus: substrate geometry and early cleaning protocols.
Defects in play: Bowing and Warping, Substrate Contamination.
Tools unlocked: Stylus Profilometer, Four-Point Probe.
Bowed wafers can never be saved - REJECT them. Contaminated wafers clean up at the wet bench - REWORK them. Clean wafers pass - ACCEPT.
Tolerances are generous today. Accuracy matters more than speed.

DAY 2 - BREAKING THE LEAKAGE BARRIER (Gate Stack)
Focus: the shift to high-K metal gates and ALD deployment.
Defects in play: Interface Traps / Roughness, STI Voids.
Tools unlocked: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry, X-Ray Refractometry.
Strict parametric speed evaluations are in force. Rough interfaces bleed mobility and fail baseline speed - REJECT. STI seams leak between devices and cannot be extracted - REJECT / SCRAP. Clean wafers pass - ACCEPT.

DAY 3 - THE INTERCONNECT MAZE (Certification)
Focus: copper metallization, diffusion barriers, and plugs.
Defects in play: Tungsten Plug Voids, Silicide Bridging.
Tools unlocked: Electron Microscope.
Plug voids are open circuits - REJECT, no exceptions. Silicide bridges caught early can be stripped in the ultrasonic etch - REWORK. Weigh rework cost against the shift clock. Pass both gates to certify.
